assurance: Deloitte limited assurance review of FY25 Section 1 specified information; report dated July 9, 2026, p23. Not reasonable assurance; estimates retain inherent uncertainty.
caveat: Use GHGP table1A as primary baseline. Management criteria have distinct treatment for fuel certificates, aviation effects and downstream renewable electricity. Difference 831,000 tonnes is not an additional physical reduction opportunity. Crucially p16: management Category11 uses all active Surface/Xbox devices during FY25 (annual telemetry and extrapolation), while GHGP Category11 estimates lifetime use of devices sold in FY25. Third-party devices running Microsoft software are excluded in both. Thus totals differ in service cohort/time boundary, not just renewable procurement.
